claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: Estradiol cypionate is a prodrug of estradiol that acts as an estrogen receptor agonist; at 2.5 uM it is unlikely to cause substantial cytotoxicity, and any weak killing would reflect estrogen-receptor-dependent growth modulation rather than a general cytotoxic mechanism.
